checks: Read-only open shows no server draft acknowledgement
Opening/save-state presentation sends no command
Server draft status uses the actual returned revision
Editing a decimal immediately distinguishes unsaved input
Input alone does not write to the server
Actual backend save succeeds
Actual saved readback retains decimal and increments version
Save acknowledgement is displayed only after matched readback
Server save grants neither device durability nor destination acceptance
Editing after a successful save does not retain a false current-save label
Compare never acknowledges or replaces local edits
Explicit replacement restores the actual saved decimal
Lost write acknowledgement shows unresolved status instead of success
Aborted original POST leaves saved value unchanged
Exact original attempt reconciles and then displays matched readback
Recovery preserves original key and command body
Programme edits are unsaved and never silently committed
Programme-only save reports matched readback after actual persistence
Revoked authority clears both protected entries and their save-state region
No client runtime error or external request
limits: Built local synthetic backend and Chromium. Bounded save-state increment only; programme edits, confirmed/voided presentation and original authority refusal are additional qualified checks. No full cancellation/exchange acceptance, physical device, formal UAT or hosting.
